body: Suresh ji, aapke Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 ko corporate bulk ke liye 30‑person pack mein ₹4,200 (₹140 per plate) set kar sakte hain, jo aapke Indiranagar footfall aur 18 orders/day ke average ko dhyan mein rakhte hue profitable rahega. Is package mein free starter (₹120 value) har 10 plates par include hai aur delivery share ko 45% se kam rakhne ke liye self‑pickup option bhi add kar sakte hain. Confirm karen?
rationale: Provides a concrete bulk thali package with pricing and perks, leveraging the merchant's existing thali offer and performance data; uses Hindi‑English mix and ends with a binary yes/no confirmation.

body: Padma, here’s a ready draft: 4‑week kids yoga summer camp, 3 classes/week, ages 7‑12, ₹2,499 per child (includes 1 free trial class). We can add a free body composition analysis for parents as a bonus. Shall I create the GBP post and Instagram carousel now?
rationale: Provided a concrete program and pricing based on the merchant’s active planning intent, using energetic_disciplined tone with English‑primary code‑mix and a single binary yes/no CTA to externalize effort.

body: Hi Aditya, this is Karim from Karim's Salon. We have you booked for tomorrow at 11:00 AM. Please confirm if this works or let us know if you’d like to reschedule.
rationale: Uses the customer’s name and merchant owner name, matches the warm practical Hindi‑English tone (in English as per preference), and asks a simple confirm/cancel question about the appointment time, fulfilling the trigger’s low‑friction confirmation requirement.

body: Hi Riya, yeh reminder hai aapke kal ke appointment ke liye. Kya aapka time confirm hai? Reply YES to confirm ya NO to reschedule.
rationale: Used customer name and Hindi-English code-mix per language_pref. Since payload is a placeholder with no specific time, the message asks for confirmation of the existing appointment rather than stating a specific time, adhering to the rule against inventing facts. The CTA is a simple binary yes/no as per the framing hint.

body: Ramesh ji, summer trends show antifungal demand up 45% and ORS up 40%. Your repeat rate is strong at 68%. Should I draft a shelf-stock reminder for these molecules?
rationale: Anchored on the specific seasonal trend data (antifungal +45%, ORS +40%) and the merchant's high repeat rate signal. Used a binary CTA to confirm the recommended shelf action.

body: Meera, JIDA Oct 2026 data shows 3-month fluoride varnish recall cuts caries recurrence by 38% in high-risk adults. You have 124 such patients in your chart. Want me to draft a recall message for them?
rationale: Anchored on the specific JIDA trial statistic (38% reduction) and the merchant's specific high-risk patient count (124) to create urgency. Used a binary CTA to offer drafting the recall message, leveraging the 'high_risk_adult_cohort' signal and the digest's actionable advice.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma, your Metformin, Atorvastatin, and Telmisartan are set to run out on 28‑April‑2026. As a valued senior customer, you can enjoy our 15% OFF on all prescriptions. Would you like us to refill these before the expiry?
rationale: Used customer name, ran-out date, listed molecules, added senior discount from offers, maintained trustworthy_precise tone with Hindi-English mix, asked for confirmation only.

body: Hi Vivaan, Dr. Sameer from Bright Smile Dental. Your last visit was 1st April 2026 and your routine cleaning is due soon. Would you like to book a Dental Cleaning @ ₹299?
rationale: Used merchant identity, customer name, last visit date. Offered a specific service from offer_catalog with price, respecting tone and language. Asked for confirmation only.

body: Hi Meera, I noticed Smile Studio just 1.3 km away is offering a Dental Cleaning for ₹199. Would you like to discuss how we can keep our ₹299 offer competitive by adding extra value or a bundle?
rationale: Used competitor fact (price, distance) from trigger, followed category voice (peer_clinical, Hindi-English code mix not needed), and asked a single open-ended question to prompt merchant action.

body: Hey Suresh, your recent 30‑day CTR of 3.2% is higher than the metro casual dining average of 2.5%. That’s a good sign you’re getting more clicks than peers. How do you feel about tweaking your listings to keep that edge?

body: Hi Lakshmi, just checking in – which service has been getting the most buzz this week at Studio11?

body: Suresh, a quick check—are you seeing any change in footfall or cover count on weekends compared to weekdays this week?

body: Hi Rashmi, we miss you at PowerHouse Fitness! How about a free trial class on a weekday evening – no commitment, no auto‑charge, just a chance to jump back in? Reply YES to lock in your spot or NO to pass.
rationale: Used the lapsed_hard trigger with a warm, no‑commitment free trial offer (active offer) to re‑engage the customer; binary yes/no CTA aligns with the framing hint.

body: Hi Reyansh, it’s Dr. Asha from Asha Dental Care. It’s been a while since your last visit on 1 April 2026 – we’ve noticed that regular cleanings help keep caries and occlusion issues at bay. We’re offering a Dental Cleaning for just ₹299 if you’d like to book a quick check‑up. Would you like to schedule it?

body: Hi Anjali, it's been a while since we last spoke. I noticed your profile has been quiet for the last month, and with 180 customers who haven't visited in 90+ days, there's a lot of potential to bring them back. What's been keeping you busy lately?
rationale: Acknowledges the 38-day gap without guilt, uses the specific lapsed customer count (180) from customer_aggregate to create curiosity, and asks an open-ended question about their current situation to re-engage naturally.

body: Hey Anand, we noticed your page’s footfall has dipped a bit lately. How about we test a quick, low‑friction promo to spark curiosity—maybe a one‑day special like a free starter on orders over ₹1,200?
rationale: Used merchant name Anand, referenced footfall dip, offered a fresh low‑friction promo idea, kept tone warm and practical, avoided guilt‑tripping, and provided a single open‑ended CTA.

body: Lakshmi ji, Diwali aane mein 188 din bache hain – aapke Kapra ke customers ke liye bridal trial ya hair spa packages ko Diwali theme ke saath highlight karna accha rahega. Kya aap is festive promo ko schedule karna chahenge?
rationale: Used the festival name and days_until from trigger, suggested a relevant seasonal offer (bridal trial/hair spa) per seasonal beats, and kept tone warm_practical with Hindi-English mix, ending with an open-ended question.

body: Pooja, with the wedding-prep and festival season kicking in, this is a great time to bring back your repeat clients who are looking to shape up. Would you like to share a quick update or a special offer to re-engage them?
rationale: Used the seasonal_beats note for Aug-Oct (wedding-prep/festival window) to suggest re-engaging repeat clients, aligning with the merchant's goal of retention during this period. The CTA is open-ended to allow the merchant to decide on the specific action.

body: Vikas, aapka pharmacy abhi verified nahi hai, jo ki 30% traffic uplift ka mauka miss kar raha hai. Aapke competitors ki average view CTR 3.8% hai, aapki 4.1% achi hai lekin verification ke saath aap aur customers tak reach badh sakti hai. Chaliye postcard ya phone call se verification shuru karte hain – aapko kya lagta hai?
rationale: Used verified status fact and 30% uplift from trigger, referenced peer CTR to highlight opportunity. Kept Hindi‑English mix as per language prefs. Asked a single yes/no to start verification.

body: Suresh, aapke match night ke liye aaj DC vs MI ka match hai aur yeh weekend hai. Aapke active offer "Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu)" is weekend pe kaam nahi karega, isliye aapko koi alag promotion set karna hoga. Kya aap is match night ke liye koi special offer launch karna chahenge?
rationale: Used match details from payload, noted weekend context, referenced active offer and its inapplicability, asked binary yes/no to launch a new offer.

body: Suresh ji, aapke Mylari South Indian Cafe ne abhi 145 reviews cross kar liye hain – bas 5 aur aur 150 ka milestone! Ye social proof aapke weekday thali aur weekend buzz ko aur highlight kar sakta hai. Kya aap is achievement ko ek Instagram post ya story mein showcase karna chahenge?
rationale: Uses the review count milestone as social proof (celebration) and prompts the merchant to create content, matching the warm_busy_practical tone and Hindi-English mix, with an open-ended CTA.

body: Mukesh ji, aapke Pizza Spot ke 30-day views 787 ho gaye hain, jo Aundh ke similar restaurants ke average (4800) se toh kam hai lekin aapka CTR 5.3% hai jo industry average 2.5% se double hai. Matlab jo log aapko dekh rahe hain, unmein se zyada log click kar rahe hain. Kya aap chahte hain ki hum is high-engagement data ko ek short update ya post mein convert karein taaki naye customers ko bhi yeh traction dikhe?
rationale: Used the merchant's specific high CTR (5.3% vs 2.5% peer) as the milestone/social proof lever, framing it as a content opportunity rather than just praise, per the framing hint.

body: Hi Bharat, we saw calls down 50% in the last 7 days compared to your 12‑day average of 12. This dip often aligns with off‑season periods, but we can counter it by running a short‑term promo like “Dental Cleaning @ ₹299”. Would you like to activate this offer now?
rationale: Mentioned the specific metric (calls) and % drop per prompt, noted seasonal beat explanation, and suggested a concrete corrective action (launching a ₹299 cleaning offer).

body: Sushma, your recent calls are 21% below the metro average – a dip that can be normal during off‑peak months. To lift this, we suggest a quick call‑back outreach to your recent visitors. Do you want us to set this up?

body: Padma, your calls are up 15% this week, likely driven by the kids yoga post. Want me to refresh that post to keep the momentum going?
rationale: Used the specific 15% call increase from the trigger payload and linked it to the likely driver (kids yoga post) to suggest capitalizing on the spike by refreshing the content.

body: Vikas ji, aapke store ki views pichhle 7 din mein 2% badhi hain aur calls 5% increase hue hain. Is momentum ko sustain karne ke liye ek naya post ya offer launch karna chaheinge?
rationale: Uses the recent 2% view and 5% call increase metrics (performance.delta_7d) to prompt the merchant to act, matching the trustworthy_precise Hindi-English voice and includes a single binary yes/no call to action.
